motionAllow.name: ds-shell-sidebar
motionAllow.reason: The design-system app shell animates its sidebar column when it collapses (css/layout.css .ds-shell). The shell owns it. Ford allowed it for knowledge-system, and this config reuses that allowance for the same shell.
